# Kevin Jojo

> AI Engineer and product-focused builder based in Cochin, Kerala, India — building reliable LLM systems, document AI workflows, evaluation frameworks, and multi-modal research.

Kevin Jojo works on the parts of LLM systems that determine whether an output can be trusted and acted on. His work includes source-grounded validation, acceptance criteria, failure analysis, human-in-the-loop fallbacks, deterministic scoring, retrieval, document extraction, and product delivery.

## Selected Experience

- Koloapp (Business Analyst / Prompt Engineer, Aug 2025–Present): shipped LLM and document-extraction systems behind Kolo Smart Select, reducing client report turnaround from days to hours; owned MyRenoWallet from customer research through specifications, UAT, launch, SOPs, and reporting.
- Workcohool Solutions (AI Engineer Intern, Jan–Jun 2025): moved a LangChain, OpenAI API, Tesseract OCR medical-report platform into a live Django application and evaluated BioBERT and ClinicalBERT.
- Familiar AI (Co-founding attempt, 2026): explored a personal and company memory layer, led customer discovery and MVP definition, applied to Y Combinator, pitched Indian pre-seed investors, and paused the venture based on evidence.
- E-Cell Karunya (Leadership, 2023–2024): led corporate partnerships, recruitment, and onboarding for a 500+ member entrepreneurship cell.

- Education: Karunya University; De Paul Public School (2019–2021, Class 11–12); Village International School (2007–2019)
